budget_rationale.sense: 8 ns sense demonstrated at 2.5 V in FERAM-03 p1/Fig11; 20/50 ns are longer design windows within its 1-50 ns sweep, not measured complete read periods
budget_rationale.polarization: FERAM-03 reports 14 ns write latency, not a proven isolated single polarity pulse. Model deliberately reserves 14/50/100 ns for EACH target-polarity phase in selected two-phase PL implementation. 50 ns is within Fig11 sweep; 100 ns characterization is in Figs10/12. No claim that original 14 ns measurement required two times 14 ns.
budget_rationale.dedicated_open_close: 20/40/80 ns total allocation for BL precharge/reference, WL/PL bias establishment, pulse edges, SA reset and return to reusable state excluding polarization holds. Short=10+10 ns open/close (round above 8 ns observed sense); reference=20+20; long=40+40. FERAM-03 Fig9 establishes required stages; FERAM-04 Fig13 tRP=80 ns and complete tRC=185 ns cross-check scale, NOT a disjoint timing block to add. No PVT guarantee or measured per-stage split. Fixed80uA/BL driver rating coversshort62.5uA/BL capacitive edge demand at250fF and2.5V; PL switched-charge lower bound is accounted separately, not treated as a full rating.
budget_rationale.voltage: Measured anchor FERAM-03: 11 nm TiN/HZO/TiN, 2.5 V, 1 um2 capacitor tested. Memory voltage domain and compatible access/level-shift circuitry retained as a design requirement; shared 28 nm 0.9 V applies to digital periphery only, with no geometric speed scaling.
budget_rationale.write_parallelism: 128 target BL drivers and one selected local plate driver provisioned for a whole128bit row, independently of 128bit input interface; 32 read SA banks support parallel restore from their own latches. Updating externally is serialized by choice to one target-data/decoder domain. 4096 restore BLs demand128mA capacitive edge current atreference20ns, compared with4mA for128 external targetBLs;32 PL domains add polarization/dielectric demand.
budget_rationale.endpoint: Open-loop binary write, no analog verify or unspecified retries. Conditional capacity is for cells passing binary-state read/write qualification under stated window; failure beyond budget is failed service, not extra successful payload.

read_includes: capture SA output into existing 4096-bit operand register before reset; capture already budgeted in dedicated open/close control; hold through 8 input-bit computations
stage_coverage.refresh: No scheduled refresh in active service window for remanent 1T1C state. Destructive writeback is paid every physical read. Retention/lifetime separate; no C2 floating-node assumption.
stage_coverage.read_latch_condition: D0 existing 4096-bit register survives SA reset, has disabled write enable through all 8 input slices, and is read-only during computation; output accumulator is separate. No overlap with next group and no extra capture slot.

reuse_sensitivity.purpose: Same hardware and timing, but discard operand after one input bit and physically reread/restore each time; voluntary scheduling contrast, not a medium requirement.
